steps.text: Coconut (6/8 g) toasted in a dry pan, 90 seconds, shaken constantly, out the moment it turns gold.
Blueberries (90/110 g) — if frozen, straight from the freezer into the skyr and left 5 minutes. They bleed, and it turns purple, which is better.
Skyr (170/220 g), berries, then coconut and pumpkin seeds (8/11 g) over.

why: Frozen berries beat fresh here, and cost a third as much. As they thaw against the skyr they release juice that sweetens the whole pot — fresh ones just sit on top of it.
notes: No ruled defects or D0-003 substitutions apply (no oil, no lettuce; coconut is already fully weighed in the existing covers table). The berries' 5-minute steep is passive, not active — active time (~2 min toast+assembly) matches the card's 3-minute chip; total wall-clock is longer because of the passive wait.
